description.es: Un servicio recurrente para clientes que ya han trabajado con Synnergy Lab y necesitan mantener, medir y mejorar el sistema implementado. El objetivo no es volver a empezar cada mes, sino convertir los datos y aprendizajes acumulados en ajustes continuos.
description.en: A recurring service for clients who have already worked with Synnergy Lab and need to maintain, measure and improve the system already in place. The objective is not to restart every month, but to turn accumulated data and learning into continuous improvements.
